name: V (vlang)
description: `v up` does git pull + recompile-and-run with only git's integrity, no signature/pinned key — GitHub-account compromise ⇒ RCE. Windows bootstrap downloads+executes an .exe with zero verification.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted source read supports this narrow assessment: The CLI self-update pulls the vlang master branch over HTTPS and recompiles the fetched source; no release signature or pinned hash verification is used.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact behavior or upstream configuration.
Where verification is delegated to an external framework/package, that implementation was not vendored and remains unresolved.

original_evidence.text: | V (vlang) | https://github.com/vlang/v.git | d934e4beafd3c071edc976684773bb880fe05ef8 / 2026-08-23 | Y | N (manual `v up`) | Y | https (git pull over https; git enforces TLS by default, no override found) | N/A (no manifest) | none — relies solely on git's SHA-1 object-integrity chain; no GPG-signed-commit verification, no release signature, no hash pinning | N/A — unauthenticated, trust is "whatever `https://github.com/vlang/v` `master` HEAD currently is" | `cmd/tools/vup.v:83-99` `update_from_master()` runs `git pull --rebase https://github.com/vlang/v master` (or on first run `git remote add origin …; git fetch; git reset --hard origin/master`), then `recompile_v()` (`:123-146`) executes `v self` / `make`, i.e. compiles and will subsequently run the newly-fetched, newly-compiled source — self-update-and-execute. Additionally `cmd/tools/vup.v:260-278` `install_git()`, invoked when git is missing on Windows, downloads a hardcoded installer `https://github.com/git-for-windows/git/releases/download/v2.30.0.windows.2/Git-2.30.0.2-32-bit.exe` via `bitsadmin.exe /transfer` and then **directly executes it** (`os.execute(os.quoted_path(...))` at `:273`) with **zero hash/signature verification**. `v up` is a manual/opt-in command (not auto-triggered). |
